digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence and rotation state management
propositions: The inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after successful new-writer saves, requiring sidecar persistence to complete before inline scrubbing occurs.
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value retained as a failure floor.
A crash or failure after sidecar replace but before bindings replace must not lose the chronological maximum rotation value, which must already be durable in the sidecar.
Mixed old-writer and new-writer sequences must converge by migrating the later inline timestamp into get_rotation.json before scrubbing the inline field.

The persistence contract must maintain chronological max semantics: merge all staged inline values into the sidecar, atomically persist get_rotation.json, then remove inline fields and atomically write bindings.json.
Anti-starvation guarantee and packed repository cost per changed version must remain at or below A2-1 baseline measurements.
